THE GERMANS PRINT THEIR COUNTER-PROPOSALS IN A TRAIN.

More paper arrives for the Press on which the Germans are printing their own terms. It has been installed in a special train which has been brought from the Fatherland to Versailles. They rejected certain terms, but are offering to pay compensation of £1, 000,000,000 in gold by 1926. Photo shows;- The German railway wagon in which printing press is installed.
